description: This file manages caching mechanisms for Python packages, including wheel files and general cache directories. It defines classes for cache handling, such as Cache, SimpleWheelCache, EphemWheelCache, and WheelCache, along with related functions for cache key generation and cache entry management.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: An abstract class providing cache directory management and cache key generation for linked resources.

classes.name: SimpleWheelCache
classes.description: A cache class specifically for wheel files, inheriting from Cache, storing wheel files in a structured cache directory.

classes.name: EphemWheelCache
classes.description: Ephemeral wheel cache that creates its own temporary directory, inheriting from SimpleWheelCache.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with associated link, persistence status, and optional origin metadata.

classes.name: WheelCache
classes.description: Composite cache that uses both persistent and ephemeral caches for wheel files, with methods to retrieve cache entries.

methods.name: str _hash_dict(d: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Generates a stable sha224 hash for a given dictionary, producing a consistent cache key.

methods.name: Cache.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Cache with a root cache directory and asserts it is an absolute path.

methods.name: Cache._get_cache_path_parts
methods.description: Constructs parts of a cache path based on the link's URL, hash, subdirectory, and interpreter info.

methods.name: Cache.get_path_for_link
methods.description: Abstract method to compute cache directory path for a specific link.

methods.name: Cache.get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a link to a cached item if available.

methods.name: SimpleWheelCache.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the simple wheel cache with a specified cache directory.

methods.name: SimpleWheelCache.get_path_for_link
methods.description: Returns a directory path where cached wheel files for a link are stored.

methods.name: SimpleWheelCache.get
methods.description: Attempts to find a cached wheel matching the package name and supported tags; returns original link if none found.

methods.name: EphemWheelCache.__init__
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory as its cache location.

methods.name: CacheEntry.__init__
methods.description: Constructs a cache entry, attempting to read origin information from an associated JSON file.

methods.name: WheelCache.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the combined cache with both persistent and ephemeral cache components.

methods.name: WheelCache.get_path_for_link
methods.description: Delegates to the persistent cache to determine cache path for a link.

methods.name: WheelCache.get_ephem_path_for_link
methods.description: Delegates to the ephemeral cache to determine cache path for a link.

methods.name: WheelCache.get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached link if available, prioritizing persistent cache, then ephemeral.

methods.name: WheelCache.get_cache_entry
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a cache entry from both persistent and ephemeral caches.

methods.name: WheelCache.record_download_origin
methods.description: Records the origin info for a download in the cache directory, overwriting if necessary.
